DMCA and Takedown Requests

SimpanClip does not store or display videos. Videos are fetched temporarily from the source platform at the user's request.

If you are a copyright holder and want a specific link or account blocked from SimpanClip, email hello@simpanclip.com with: (1) the link to the original video, (2) proof that you hold the rights or act for the holder, (3) your name and contact details, (4) a statement that the information is accurate.

We will review complete requests and act on them as quickly as possible.
